deviations.what: sap.ui.layout.cssgrid.ResponsiveColumnLayout (the CSSGrid customLayout this sample is about) and sap.ui.layout.cssgrid.ResponsiveColumnItemLayoutData (its per-card columns/rows layout data) are both @since 1.72, one minor release past the 1.71 floor, and so is the layout's layoutChange event with its layout parameter. All are kept 1:1 - the sample's owning control sap.ui.layout.cssgrid.CSSGrid is in scope and the sample is nothing without them; declared per the fidelity-first property-171 policy, so the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.72.

The 'Reveal Grid' ToggleButton keeps its label but loses its press attribute: onRevealGrid calls RevealGrid.toggle('grid1', view) from the sample-local module RevealGrid/RevealGrid.js, which measures the rendered grid and draws an absolutely positioned outline overlay over every grid cell. That is a sample-only JS helper with its own CSS, not a control, property or whitelisted control method, and it is not loadable in an abap2UI5 app - the same drop as apps 145/222/271/346. onExit's RevealGrid.destroy goes with it.

Slider.liveChange is dropped for a binding: onSliderMoved calls byId('panelCSSGrid').setWidth(fValue + '%'), and sap.m.Panel HAS a width property, so the Slider's value is two-way bound and the Panel's width is an expression binding over it - roundtrip-free, the app-222/176 idiom. onLayoutChange stays a real round-trip because there is nothing to bind against: the layout reports its breakpoint in the layoutChange event, so the wire carries ${$parameters>/layout} to the backend and on_event writes it into the field the 'Current breakpoint' Text binds - the same write the original's setProperty('/currentBreakpoint', ...) does.

The original's model has one field (currentBreakpoint, initially empty) and the view binds it as {/currentBreakpoint}; folded onto the one default model it is client->_bind( currentbreakpoint ) - same data, same leaf name. It is seeded empty like the original, so the Text reads 'Current breakpoint: ' until the first layoutChange fires.

Unverified in a running system: whether the layoutChange round-trip fills the breakpoint Text as the panel is resized, and whether the Panel width expression follows the slider live. **e2e-verified 2026-08-25** (nightly e2e interaction, meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_348.mjs).
